findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：無單一客戶超過 10% 淨銷售，前十大客戶占 45%（FY2025 44%、FY2024 37%）。
findings.excerpt: In fiscal year 2026, our ten largest customers accounted for 45% of net sales. No customer accounted for greater than 10% of the Company's net sales in fiscal year 2026.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：部分超大規模客戶已發展或可能發展內部設計/工程/製造能力與 Flex 競爭，垂直整合、in-source 或轉單競爭者可能重大不利影響；Cloud 與 Power 業務集中度尤高。屬風險揭露，未點名具體客戶已自製。
findings.excerpt: certain hyperscale customers have developed, or may develop, internal design, engineering, or manufacturing capabilities that compete with our offerings. These customers may choose to reduce their reliance on third-party providers like us over time, which could result in reduced order volumes, loss of programs, or increased pricing pressure.

note: 搜尋未見具體客戶導入第二供應商或自製 Flex 業務的報導，僅風險揭露。
